newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani police arrest Bhutto's father-in-law.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani police arrest Bhutto's father-in-law.

text.p: Ousted Pakistani Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto's father-in-law Hakim Ali Zardari had been detained for interrogation, police said on Thursday.
Zardari, a former federal minister and father of Bhutto's husband Asif Ali Zardari, who is under arrest, was picked up from his home overnight, one police official said.
The official could not give the exact charges against him but said he would be interrogated by the officials of the Federal Investigation Agency.
